about: Angelo's command centre settings, and his first view (his answer on 3 November); the classic dashboard follows the same order. Kept by dashboard@web-summit.angelo (people/angelo/ only); admin/build/commandcentre.mjs reads this and takes the rest from its defaults. The order follows Angelo's five questions: what needs me now, is everyone connected, is the machine healthy, the technical pool with Jose, and what my agents did. Issues, decisions on the stand-up agenda and agents' commits are always read from the board, data/meetings/ and git; nothing here copies a number. Public: no contact details, no keys.

workstreams.name: Is everyone connected?
workstreams.goal: Everyone at L4 (dashboard agent running, agents' keys published): who is stuck on /team/setup/ and at which step (WS-35), one consistent GitHub hand-off (WS-124 against WS-09), and the vaults next (WS-120).

workstreams.name: The machine
workstreams.goal: main protected and 'never push to main' enforced (WS-105, WS-90), every release through a green gate, CI failures seen the same hour, every running agent's key published (WS-45), and the estate's repository standard met (WS-106).

workstreams.name: The technical pool with Jose
workstreams.goal: One pool for Angelo and Jose: each issue has a name in picked_by, and the two choose who takes what.

workstreams.name: Running the team
workstreams.goal: Every stand-up on the calendar with a brief, a debrief and follow-ups (WS-96), and a daily note on bottlenecks (WS-97).

workstreams.name: RiskMandate, friendlies and content
workstreams.goal: The demos and landing page for RiskMandate, Daniela's agentic team and site, and the technical articles.

conductor.job: The hub: sends Angelo's agents work and takes their reports in commits, keeps people/angelo/, and brings Angelo what only he can decide

dev.job: Angelo's own command centre (people/angelo/app/BRIEF.md) and drafts for the technical pool
dev.schedule: every two hours, round the clock (cron 35 */2 * * *)

team-collaboration.job: The stand-up calendar, a brief, debrief and follow-ups for every meeting (WS-96), and the daily bottleneck note (WS-97)

dashboard.job: Keeps Angelo's command centre and the classic dashboard, for his conductor under the protocol
dashboard.schedule: every three hours, round the clock (cron 30 */3 * * *)

vault.job: Creates and manages Angelo's SGit vaults, audits each before its read key is published, and corrects the vault guide from its runs (WS-120)

helper.job: Answers setup questions from anyone on the team and keeps the help page (/help/)
helper.schedule: every two hours, round the clock (proposed)

decisions.what: The lane to your conductor: unblocks sealed messages (slice 3) and the vault-to-vault lanes with Silvio (WS-120)
decisions.recommend: Yes: a write-only append lane on a vault of vault@web-summit.angelo, sealed to conductor@web-summit.angelo's key (tier 3, your go).

decisions.what: The presence agent: team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo as the team's one presence agent (everyone's locations)
decisions.recommend: Propose it at a stand-up first: everyone's locations would be opened by an agent in your account.
